name: deep lunge to hamstring stretch
description: A flowing stretch from a deep lunge into a straight front leg. It opens the hip flexors and stretches the hamstrings.
instructions: Step into a deep lunge with both hands on the floor.
Hold for a breath and feel the front of the back hip open.
Shift your hips back and straighten the front leg.
Flex your front foot and fold gently over it.
Return to the lunge and switch legs.
